strategy.name: Regime-conditioned RV mean-reversion (Phase 2)
strategy.desc: Fade a spread when it dislocates >=1.5sigma from a robust (median/MAD) rolling fair value, in agreement with the daily fundamentals model; exit on reversion through to fair (|z|<=0.1), a tighter 2.5sigma stop, an OU half-life time stop, or a session break. The Phase-2 strategy, backtested intraday with optional net-of-cost gating.
